jobs.objective:
Project site: https://hamsterhour.fun
Ethereum, paired with IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7. Token is a plain ERC-20 (no tax, mint, burn or owner). Send the 80% remainder (800M) to HamsterVault 0x1dceb78b36b5f18ac4a130f1ffc76eba0e73d183 if the launch allows it.

Vault (github.com/identity-md-launches/launch-2304-project-site-https-hamsterhour-fun-launc): depositRewards, depositDrip, forwardJackpot, forwardOracle (uint256), each pulling IMD via transferFrom.

HOOK FEE: 1.1% of the actual IMD leg of every swap (buy input or sell output), all swap modes, real deltas. 0.5% to depositRewards, 0.5% to forwardJackpot, 0.1% to forwardOracle.

ANTI-SNIPE: buy-only tax on the IMD leg from pool start: 95% in minute 0, minus 2 points per full minute, 0 from minute 48. Sells never taxed. Tax: 80% to depositDrip, 10% to forwardOracle, 10% to TEAM. Total fees with IMD's launch fee never exceed 100%.

SAFETY: PoolManager-only, immutable pool key, no fee bypass, tax cannot re-arm. Fees accrue as credits and flush to the vault without ever reverting a swap (anyone can retry flush). No owner, pause, upgrade or fee change. Tests for every swap mode, each tax minute, sells untaxed, splits and a reverting vault.

Token name: Hamster Hour
Token symbol: HAMSTER
